text:
jamie (eng-platform): Heads-up — ClearBank is reporting repeated tail p99 spikes on Dedicated Pool-7 during peak. CS opened a P1. Looks tied to replication KV cache misses causing uneven load on a single replica. Need an owner for a short-term fallback (route to general pool or scale burst) + ETA for a patch.

mira (customer-success): Thanks Jamie. Customer impact: failures on large multi-turn requests, timeout 10s -> errors. They're asking for mitigation within 1h. I'm on the call if we need to message them.

sam (eng-oncall): I can take the short-term routing fallback. Quick question: do we want automatic routing to fallback pool or manual reroute? Auto might be noisy.

jamie (eng-platform): Prefer manual for now so we can watch KPIs, but need a scripted runbook. Sam — can you prepare a route toggle and validate it in staging?

patrick (eng-sre): I can own the patch to limit per-replica inflight ops and reduce backpressure. Should be a small change (KV cache semaphore + better retry). I'll open a draft PR. ETA ~3h for PR + canary, 6h to merge if approvals go smooth.

zoe (infra): If we need immediate capacity spike, I can enable burst autoscale for Pool-7 for ~30m window. That buys time while Patrick lands the patch. Will be manual unless we flip autoscale policy.

sam (eng-oncall): I'll put together the runbook for manual reroute: steps + verification. Short checklist: 1) drain new requests to general pool, 2) monitor p99 and error-rate, 3) revert after stable. Will test in staging in 10m.

jamie (eng-platform): Patrick — please include a small toggle flag in the PR to disable fancy prefetching (cheap off) so we can test behaviour. Also add a short description for CS so we can explain the fix.

patrick (eng-sre): yep. Draft PR: https://git.redwood/repo/patches/PR-4021 — includes semaphore, prefetch toggle, and a regression test. Patch branch runs unit + integration.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for PR-4021 to canary Pool-3.

zoe (infra): Canary looks healthy so far (10m). No spike in error rates. If it stays clean for 15m, we can schedule a wider canary.

mira (customer-success): I'll tell ClearBank we have a two-phase plan: immediate capacity bump (10-30m) + runbook switch if needed, and a patch ETA ~6h. They want a confirmation message once manual reroute is ready.

sam (eng-oncall): Staging runbook test passed. I posted the toggle snippet in #playbooks. Snippet:
```
# toggle manual reroute
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://api.redwood/internal/routing/toggle \
  -d '{"pool_from":"pool-7","pool_to":"general-pool","state":"enable"}'
```

jamie (eng-platform): Perfect. Sam, can you execute the toggle when Mira confirms the customer message? I'll coordinate post-reroute validation windows.

patrick (eng-sre): Canary -> wider canary scheduled in 30m if no regressions. If all good, aim to merge by EOD.

mira (customer-success): ClearBank ack'd the short-term plan. Please ping me when the manual reroute is live and again when the PR is merged.

jamie (eng-platform): Thanks all. Owners: Sam (manual reroute + runbook, now), Zoe (burst autoscale, immediate), Patrick (patch + PR), Mira (customer comms). I'll update incident doc and follow up on postmortem owners. :thumbsup:

sam (eng-oncall): Executing manual reroute now.

deploy-bot: routing toggle executed by sam (eng-oncall).

zoe (infra): Burst autoscale enabled for Pool-7 for 30m window.

jamie (eng-platform): Customer notified. Monitoring p99 and error rate — watching dashboards. Will post final status in 15m.

patrick (eng-sre): PR updated with test logs and prefetch toggle description. Link above.

mira (customer-success): ClearBank says errors dropped immediately after reroute. They appreciate the quick turnaround.

jamie (eng-platform): Great. Leaving this thread here for async updates. If anything changes, please @channel. Thanks everyone.
